choices.why: There is no green velvet sofa in the catalog, so this dark charcoal three-seater with rolled arms and black turned legs is the closest to the classic, elegant look you asked for.
A pair of matching rolled-arm armchairs from the same line as the sofa, facing each other beside the fireplace, forms a cohesive traditional group.
The largest hand-knotted Persian rug brings the traditional pattern and warm reds that anchor the seating group on the pale wood floor.
This dark wood rectangular table has a length that suits the three-seater and fits neatly between the sofa and the mantel.
A large rectangular mirror with a dark molded frame goes well with the black mantel and the room's classic moldings.
The pleated fabric shade on a slim base is the most classic option and gives soft light next to an armchair.

answer.why: The charcoal upholstery, dark wood and dark mirror frame echo the black mantel, while the red Persian rug and the fabric-shade lamp add warmth and traditional elegance to the pale green paneled walls. The catalog has no green velvet sofa, so the sofa and armchairs are dark charcoal instead of the green you asked for.
